# //go:embedbuild embeds a build of another package for another target.
[short] skip 'builds a js/wasm binary'

go build -o main$GOEXE .
exec ./main$GOEXE
stdout '^blob/README$'
stdout '^blob/app.wasm.gz$'
stdout '^module magic 0061736d$'

# Equal inputs give equal bytes.
go build -o main2$GOEXE .
cmp main$GOEXE main2$GOEXE

# The wasm link and the gzip come from the build cache.
go build -x -o main3$GOEXE .
! stderr 'GOARCH=.wasm. .*link -o'
! stderr 'gzip -9'

# go install pkg@version builds the embedded package at the same version.
env GOFLAGS=-modcacherw
go install -n example.com/embedbuild@v1.0.0
stderr 'GOOS=.js. GOARCH=.wasm. .*link -o'
stderr 'gzip -9 -n < .* > .*app.wasm.gz # internal'
go install example.com/embedbuild@v1.0.0
exec $GOPATH/bin/embedbuild$GOEXE
stdout '^blob/app.wasm.gz$'
env GOFLAGS=

# A package that embeds a build of itself for the same target is an error.
! go build -o self.out ./self
stderr '^//go:embedbuild self.bin: cycle: example.com/eb/self js/wasm -> example.com/eb/self js/wasm$'

# The name must fall under a //go:embed pattern.
! go build -o bad.out ./bad
stderr 'nothere/x is not under any //go:embed pattern'

# Any target works: here a Windows and a Linux arm64 executable.
go build -o cross.out ./cross
exec ./cross.out
stdout '^win 4d5a$'
stdout '^arm64 7f454c46 b7$'

# A file of the same name on disk must be marked -fallback.
! go build -o nofb.out ./nofb
stderr 'blob/app.bin exists; mark it -fallback'
! go build -o missing.out ./missing
stderr 'fallback, but blob/x.bin does not exist'

# The build replaces a -fallback file, and -embedbuild=off keeps it.
go build -o fb.out ./fb
exec ./fb.out
stdout '^0061736d$'
go build -embedbuild=off -o fb.out ./fb
exec ./fb.out
stdout '^66616c6c$'
go list -embedbuild=off -f '{{range .EmbedBuilds}}{{.Inactive}}{{end}}' ./fb
stdout '^-embedbuild=off$'
go list -f '{{range .EmbedBuilds}}{{.Name}} {{.Fallback}} [{{.Inactive}}]{{end}}' ./fb
stdout '^blob/app.bin true \[\]$'

# A directive in a dependency is inactive, so it adds no build to importers.
cd dep
go get example.com/embedbuild@v1.0.0
go list -deps -f '{{.ImportPath}} {{range .EmbedBuilds}}[{{.Inactive}}]{{end}}' .
stdout '^example.com/embedbuild/lib \[not in a module being built\]$'
go build -x -o dep.out .
! stderr 'GOARCH=.wasm.'
exec ./dep.out
stderr '^lib fallback$'
cd ..

-- go.mod --
module example.com/eb

go 1.27
-- blob/README --
committed
-- wasm/main.go --
package main

func main() { println("wasm") }
-- main.go --
//go:embedbuild -gzip blob/app.wasm.gz GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm example.com/eb/wasm

package main

import (
	"compress/gzip"
	"embed"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
)

//go:embed blob
var blob embed.FS

func main() {
	fs.WalkDir(blob, "blob", func(p string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if !d.IsDir() {
			fmt.Println(p)
		}
		return nil
	})
	f, err := blob.Open("blob/app.wasm.gz")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	zr, err := gzip.NewReader(f)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	b, err := io.ReadAll(zr)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("module magic %x\n", b[:4])
}
-- self/self.bin --
-- self/main.go --
//go:embedbuild -fallback self.bin GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm example.com/eb/self

package main

import _ "embed"

//go:embed self.bin
var b []byte

func main() { println(len(b)) }
-- bad/main.go --
//go:embedbuild nothere/x GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm example.com/eb/wasm

package main

func main() {}
-- fb/blob/app.bin --
fallback
-- fb/main.go --
//go:embedbuild -fallback blob/app.bin GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm example.com/eb/wasm

package main

import (
	"embed"
	"fmt"
)

//go:embed blob
var blob embed.FS

func main() {
	b, err := blob.ReadFile("blob/app.bin")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%x\n", b[:4])
}
-- nofb/blob/app.bin --
committed
-- nofb/main.go --
//go:embedbuild blob/app.bin GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm example.com/eb/wasm

package main

import "embed"

//go:embed blob
var blob embed.FS

func main() { _ = blob }
-- missing/blob/README --

package main

import "embed"

//go:embed blob
var blob embed.FS

func main() { _ = blob }

-- dep/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/embedbuild/lib"

func main() { println("lib", lib.Data()) }
-- cross/blob/README --
-- cross/main.go --
//go:embedbuild blob/win.exe GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 example.com/eb/wasm
//go:embedbuild -strip blob/arm64 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 GOARM64=v8.0 example.com/eb/wasm

package main

import (
	"embed"
	"fmt"
)

//go:embed blob
var blob embed.FS

func main() {
	w, _ := blob.ReadFile("blob/win.exe")
	a, _ := blob.ReadFile("blob/arm64")
	fmt.Printf("win %x\n", w[:2])
	fmt.Printf("arm64 %x %x\n", a[:4], a[18])
}
